title: Independent bulk-property test of corrected diamond germanium
difficulty_reasons: Fixed bulk system and observables, but the Agent must independently implement and validate a qualitative orbital-correction hypothesis.
Elastic-response and band-edge validation require coupled structural/electronic reasoning.

paper.title: An Accurate Alternative to Hybrid Functionals for Germanium: DFT+α
paper.journal: The Journal of Physical Chemistry C

data.description: Closed JSON specification of neutral two-atom diamond Ge and qualitative correction boundary.

required_deliverables.description: Machine-readable methods, validation, observables, comparison, conclusion and limitations.
Optional detailed convergence and fit diagnostics referenced by results.json.
